label: Dry cooking batch weight vs OOSW
why: Abalone cooked for dry cooking cannot exceed the OOSW weight recorded for the job on REC 7.1.5 - a higher total means batches from different jobs got mixed. Blanching-only pots are not counted; a pot that is blanched then cooked counts once.
message: Cooked pot weight exceeding OOSW - possible batch mix
